summary: This bill disapproves a Department of the Interior rule regarding oil, gas, and sulfur operations in the Outer Continental Shelf, which would prevent the rule from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves a rule related to oil and gas operations in the Outer Continental Shelf. By nullifying a rule that likely aimed to update or strengthen regulations for high-pressure, high-temperature operations, it would effectively reduce environmental protections or prevent their enhancement, thus pushing towards less environmental regulation.
